description: Use this when you need to know what a regular expression actually matches. Example prompt: "Does this regex match every email address in this text?" Run a JavaScript regular expression against a test string using a real regex engine. Returns all matches with capture groups and indices. Costs 1 credit. The answer is deterministic.

flags.description: Regex flags such as g, i, m, s, u (default g)

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source, without the slashes

text.description: The text to run the expression against

name: test_regex

result.description: The result, when it is not an object

title: Regex Tester
